question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is Requirements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given passage the correct option to be filled in the blank is Requirements.
 
• Requirements: Something you have to accomplish or what you need.
 
 
• Example: *Many jobs have a minimum requirement of a decent degree.*
 
 
 
• *​​*Therefore the correct option is Requirements.

​The complete sentence is: **This was done to make sure that it met his requirements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Desire **refers to having a strong interest in something.
 
• **Wish **refers to expressing your sorrow or regret over a current status or circumstance.
 
• **Condition **refers to the specific state that something or someone is in is described.
